Scans the docs/process/ object tree, migrates any legacy UUID identities to
deterministic CAS (Content-Addressable Storage) SHA256 hashes, and safely cleans
up orphaned object files.

This command helps transition legacy object IDs to the new stable CAS storage
scheme.

  Migrate all legacy items
  zqk.test system migrate-cas
  Migrate but keep old files (not recommended)
  zqk.test system migrate-cas --remove-old-files=false

Usage:
  zqk.test system migrate-cas [flags]

Flags:
      --remove-old-files   Remove old ID-based files after migration (default true)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
